trials.name: Initial contact operator extraction
trials.detail: The old prepare helper materialized a dense rank-five pivot product and the adult audit exhausted memory while another solve was running. No result was accepted from that failed attempt.

trials.name: Matrix-free pivot preparation
trials.detail: G/T/C controls omit the unused bulk/pivot matrix. Actual corrected residual and Newton solver evaluate the same pivot penalty as five rank-one actions. Original model and candidate residuals were independently rechecked.

trials.name: Native Word export
trials.detail: Initial COM creation was denied in the sandbox. Authorized read-only hidden Word exports succeeded outside that sandbox, with unchanged source DOCX hashes.

scope: Implementation/resource history. These are not product durability or physical passes.
